verdict.rationale: Gecko's API (confirmed via OpenAPI spec) can trigger scans, read scan/repo/vulnerability data, triage findings, manage schedules, rotate tokens, and receive webhooks (gecko-security-docs-10, gecko-security-probe-3), and a separate AI-tool/MCP integration lets an agent pull evidence, triage, and file tickets (gecko-security-docs-9, gecko-security-probe-4). However, some UI-only workflows like one-click 'Request fix' PR creation and direct Jira/Linear/ClickUp ticket creation are documented as UI actions without explicit confirmation they're exposed as API endpoints in v1 API docs. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for PR patch requests and ticket creation, independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
